title: Chapter 13
content_zh: The battle between the forces of King Wu of Zhou and King Zhou of Shang was not merely a human war — it was a contest between the Chan sect and the Jie sect, two branches of the same immortal tradition that had split over questions of philosophy, power, and destiny.
content_en: The battle between the forces of King Wu of Zhou and King Zhou of Shang was not merely a human war — it was a contest between the Chan sect and the Jie sect, two branches of the same immortal tradition that had split over questions of philosophy, power, and destiny.
